#### This is release for:
  - version: "0.7.1"
  - revision: "b735ef1e"
  - timestamp: "Fri Sep 11 12:28:30 2026"

#### What's Changed:
- Merge pull request #32 from The-Big-Mini/MiniStoreFork
- chore(release): bump version to 0.7.1
- fix(settings): round the bottom of the Advanced Settings card
- refactor(settings): keep row icons on the root category list only
- Merge remote-tracking branch 'upstream/develop' into MiniStoreFork
- updated sidesign to latest
- added more fields available from api response for display
- show count in the certificates section header
- fixes for fetching all certs merged from both sources (developer, developerservices2) in case of paid accts while only developerservices2 in case of free accts
- do not limit cert create to specific types and let the apis throw
- implemented rest of the cert types that are legacy
- added CSR request type of cert before hand when doing a create
- fixes for profile generate view to properly show all the params during creation
- updated submodule to latest
- rewokr profile management in dev portal screen to match it with sidesign's profile management capabilities
- updated dev portal apis to use updated profile management apis
- added sidesign request headers customizations
- make all request headers fully customizable
- include option to erase ani header customizations
- diag: added dumping request headers in verbose mode
- updated to latest
- fix: make anisette client config fully customizable and move them together under anisette section of user customizations
- feature: make anisette client config user customizable (all anisette modes)
- fix: move out all constants throuought the app into AppConstants a central index + fix the anisette default client from Xcode to akd thereby fixing 5XX errors
- updated sidesign to latest

apps.name: MiniStore
apps.subtitle: SideStore with UI upgrades and preloaded sources
apps.localizedDescription:
MiniStore is SideStore with the interface sanded down.

Everything SideStore does, MiniStore does — it sideloads apps onto your device with just an Apple ID, resigns them with your personal development certificate, and refreshes them in the background so the 7-day development period never expires.

What it adds:

• OLED dark mode — true black throughout, applied live without a relaunch.
• Accent colour theming — presets or a custom colour, across every tab and the home screen widget.
• Reorganised settings — a list of categories instead of one long scroll.
• Tab customization — hide the tabs you don't use and choose which one opens on launch.
• What's New — release notes read straight from GitHub.
• A preloaded catalogue so there is something to browse immediately.

MiniStore is a thin layer on top of SideStore, kept deliberately small so upstream releases can be merged in as they land.
